notes: This dataset encodes 0 = phishing/malicious and 1 = legitimate in ClassLabel. All other columns in this CSV (url_length, has_ip_address, etc.) are IGNORED by the loader on purpose -- the pipeline recomputes every feature itself from the raw URL string using backend/feature_extractor.py, so training and inference can never drift apart. To use a different dataset, replace dataset.csv and edit only the four keys above (url_column, label_column, phishing_label_value, legitimate_label_value).
